text:
Type: striped flatweave wool rug
Use: covering a floor, defining an entry; entryway, living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, bohemian, rustic
Materials: wool flatweave, small corner tassels
Colors: warm sand beige, cream, brown, red, yellow, blue accents
Shape: small rectangle, gabbeh-inspired irregular horizontal stripes with color-block bands, flat thin weave, light visual weight
Feel: earthy, relaxed, casual, warm
Goes with: natural wood, brick or terracotta floors, green plants; rustic, bohemian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Gabbeh Inspired Wool Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Sand Multi
product.description: 80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Designed with classic Gabbeh inspiration, this rug blends traditional style with contemporary tones. It features a tribal pattern of neutral colors, accented with single tassels on each corner. Distinctive style with sturdy construction Flat weave. Made in India. Wool/cotton blend. Highly durable 4' x 6' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
